name: Sofia Reyes
goals: Build a marketing attribution dashboard across all paid channels
Create a lead nurture email sequence system
communication_style: Creative and data-literate, talks about CAC, LTV, ROAS, A/B testing; uses HubSpot and GA4 terminology
pain_points: Attribution is broken, Facebook, Google, and internal all claim credit for the same conversion
Manually pulling reports every Monday takes half the day
Email sequences are maintained in spreadsheets, embarrassingly manual
sample_prompts: Build a multi-touch attribution dashboard that unifies spend and conversion data from Google Ads, Meta, and HubSpot with ROAS by channel
Create an automated campaign performance report system that runs every Monday and sends a branded PDF summary to leadership
Build a lead nurture workflow engine that triggers personalized email sequences based on user behavior and lead score
